name: services-2
title: Services 2
description: Service section layouts for agencies, consultancies, and internal platform teams.

files.content:
--- import type { ImageMetadata } from "astro" import { Image } from "astro:assets" import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Section, SectionContainer, SectionTitle, } from "@/components/ui/section" import PlaceholderImage from "@/assets/placeholder.svg" type Props = HTMLAttributes<"section"> & { badge: string title: string description: string services: { image?: { src: ImageMetadata alt: string } label: string title: string description: string button: { label: string href: string } }[] } const { class: className, badge, title, description, services, ...props } = Astro.props ---
{badge} {title}

{description}

{services.map((service) => (
{service.label}

{service.title}

{service.description}

))}

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1536" height="864" viewBox="0 0 1536 864">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="placeholder-background" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#525252" />
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#404040" />
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="placeholder-fade" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="40%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff" />
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0" />
    </radialGradient>
    <pattern id="placeholder-dots" width="20" height="20" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="2" fill="#e5e5e5" />
    </pattern>
    <mask id="placeholder-mask">
      <rect width="1536" height="864" fill="url(#placeholder-fade)" />
    </mask>
  </defs>
  <rect width="1536" height="864" fill="url(#placeholder-background)" />
  <rect width="1536" height="864" fill="url(#placeholder-dots)" mask="url(#placeholder-mask)" />
</svg>
